scope: Controlled full retained Helmholtz update-plus-solve comparison for fused numeric combinations

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

method.command: SONIUM_REQUIRE_CUDA=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 cargo test -p sonium-fem --features cuda --lib native_fused_combination_solve_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
method.profile: optimized test profile with debug information
method.modes: two retained sessions, same mesh/forms/auxiliary AMG/controls; explicit backend fusion false versus true
method.sampling: two warm sweeps per mode, nine measured sweeps, three frequencies, alternating mode order
method.gpu_isolation: only existing sanitizer PID 1716879; suspended for timing then resumed and confirmed Sl
method.excluded_repeat: /tmp/fused-fem-benchmark-repeat.log excluded from reported results because a concurrent build may have overlapped

cases.timed_window: resident numeric update plus zero-start FGMRES and synchronization; excludes initial setup, host reference and output download

decision.reason: Numeric updates improved, but account for only 0.2-0.3% of measured time; complete-solve differences are sub-percent and mixed. No consistent general speedup established.
decision.next_target: profile solver and auxiliary preconditioner iteration costs before further numeric-combination tuning

limitations: Four bounded 2D P1/P2 Helmholtz cases, 81-2401 DOFs; not representative of all FEM scales.
Timed window excludes context/module initialization, initial preparation, independent host reference, and solution download.
Two clean timing runs; no universal statistical or performance claim.
Previous fused-combination correctness evidence remains applicable; default promotion is superseded by opt-in policy.
